title: APM · Overview
description: Application performance from OpenTelemetry traces: all applications at a glance, with links to each application, topology and trace explorer.

options.content:
**Every application that runs the OpenTelemetry agent is listed here.**  
**Web** applications answer HTTP requests: Req/s, errors and latency are filled in.  **Worker** applications (queue / job consumers) receive no HTTP requests, so those columns show **–**; for them look at *Calls out/s* (database, cache and HTTP calls they make), *Event loop* and *Heap*.  A web application also shows **–** until it has served a request in the selected time range.

panels.title: Requests / sec
panels.description: Incoming HTTP requests (server spans) per second, all selected applications.

panels.title: Error rate
panels.description: Share of incoming requests that ended in an error (HTTP 5xx or an exception).

panels.title: Avg latency
panels.description: Average request duration.

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95% of requests are faster than this.

panels.title: Calls out / sec
panels.description: Outgoing calls per second (databases, cache, HTTP). This is the activity of worker applications.

panels.title: Applications reporting
panels.description: Applications currently sending traces or runtime metrics (web and worker).

panels.title: Applications  (click a name to open its dashboard)
Applications (selected time range)
panels.description: One row per application that sends telemetry. Click the name to open its dashboard. A dash (–) means the application had no such activity in the selected range (a worker has no HTTP requests).

targets.expr: (100 * sum by (service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",service_name=~"$application",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[$__range])) / sum by (service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",service_name=~"$application"}[$__range]))) or (0 * sum by (service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",service_name=~"$application"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Requests / sec
panels.description: Incoming requests per second.

panels.title: Error rate
panels.description: Percentage of failed requests.

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95th percentile request duration.

panels.title: Responses by HTTP status
panels.description: Requests per second by HTTP status code.

panels.title: Calls out / sec
panels.description: Outgoing calls (database, cache, HTTP) per second. Shows the activity of worker applications.

panels.title: Event loop utilization
panels.description: Share of time the Node.js event loop is busy. Close to 100% = CPU-bound.

panels.title: Heap used
panels.description: V8 heap per application. A steady climb = memory leak.

panels.title: Slowest endpoints (p95)
panels.description: Top 15 endpoints by p95 latency in the selected range.

targets.expr: topk(15, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service_name, http_route) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",service_name=~"$application",http_route!=""}[$__range]))))

panels.title: Endpoints with most errors
panels.description: Top 15 endpoints by number of failed requests in the selected range.

panels.title: Latency distribution (click a dot to open its trace)
Request duration heatmap
panels.description: Each cell is a latency bucket. Dots are sample requests: click one to open its trace in Tempo.

panels.title: Traces  (click a Trace ID to open it in the Trace explorer)
Recent error traces
panels.description: Latest traces that contain an error.

panels.title: Slow traces
panels.description: Latest traces slower than the threshold chosen at the top.

panels.title: Spans received / sec (Collector)
panels.description: Spans arriving from applications. Refused > 0 means the Collector is overloaded.

panels.title: Spans sent to Tempo / sec
panels.description: Sampled spans written to Tempo. Failed > 0 means Tempo is unreachable.

panels.title: Collector memory
panels.description: Collector resident memory; tail sampling holds traces in memory.

panels.title: Traces kept by sampling
panels.description: Traces kept per sampling policy (errors, slow, baseline).

panels.title: Tempo spans ingested / sec
panels.description: Spans received by Tempo.

panels.title: Live traces in Tempo ingester
panels.description: Traces currently being assembled in Tempo.
